data.name: VIP1
data.content_en: The TikTok Store utilizes the TikTok Tasks platform daily to showcase products that need improvement. Users simply click on an order, and the system automatically generates one. Users pay for orders via the USDT blockchain, earning a commission on each order. The system also randomly assigns high-reward orders. Higher tiers yield higher earnings (new users are automatically upgraded to VIP1)
